name: WYSAPOOMP
source:
In modern day Germany, Julian's cult is getting ready to summon an Eldritch Being to the physical plane by sacrificing his childhood friend, whom he has been grooming and protecting for this purpose for years.

You’ll get to help him decide whether to do what’s morally right, to stay loyal to the cult, or to find a way to surpass his problems altogether, teaming up with one of three heroines who aligns with your decisions.

[From [url=https://crazycowlady.itch.io/wysapoomp-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在当代德国，朱利安所属的邪教正准备献祭他的一位青梅竹马，将某个不可名状的存在召唤到物质世界。多年来，他一直为了这个目的，培养并保护着这位儿时的伙伴。

你将帮助他做出决定：是遵循道德、做正确的事，忠于邪教，还是另辟蹊径，彻底摆脱困境？根据你的选择，你会与三位女主人公中志同道合的一位携手行动。

[摘自[url=https://crazycowlady.itch.io/wysapoomp-demo]itch.io[/url]]
